technological--adj.def: Relating to new machines and science.

gall--noun.def: A bitter fluid from the liver, or rude boldness.
gall--noun.ex: He had the gall to complain.

unfit--adj.def: Not suitable, or not healthy enough.
unfit--adj.ex: The water is unfit to drink.

prosperous--adj.def: Successful and having plenty of money.
prosperous--adj.ex: It was once a prosperous port.
prosperous--adj.exTr: Burası bir zamanlar müreffeh bir limandı.

symptom--noun.def: A sign of an illness that you feel or see.

discrimination--noun.def: Unfair treatment of a group of people.
discrimination--noun.ex: The law bans discrimination at work.

inscription--noun.def: Words carved into stone or metal.

moisture--noun.def: Small amounts of water in the air or in a material.

disagreement--noun.def: A situation where people have different opinions.

nectar--noun.def: The sweet liquid that bees collect from flowers.

swarm--noun.def: A large group of insects flying together.
swarm--noun.ex: A swarm of bees left the hive.

researcher--noun.def: A person who studies a subject to discover facts.

ness--noun.def: A piece of land that reaches out into the sea.
ness--noun.ex: A lighthouse stands on the ness.

imitate--verb.def: To copy the way someone speaks or behaves.

disable--verb.def: To stop a machine or a system from working.
disable--verb.exTr: Girmeden önce alarmı devre dışı bırak.

reproduce--verb.def: To produce young, or to make a copy.

coastal--adj.def: Relating to the land beside the sea.
coastal--adj.exTr: Kıyı yolları dün gece su altında kaldı.

outline--verb.def: To describe the main points of something.

residential--adj.def: Consisting of houses rather than shops or factories.
residential--adj.ex: This is a quiet residential street.

safari--noun.def: A trip to watch wild animals, especially in Africa.

boast--verb.def: To talk too proudly about what you have done.
boast--verb.ex: He boasted about his new car.

likeness--noun.def: The quality of looking similar to someone.
likeness--noun.ex: The painting is a good likeness.

auxiliary--adj.ex: The ship has an auxiliary engine.

abundance--noun.def: A very large quantity of something.
abundance--noun.ex: There was an abundance of fruit.

gallon--noun.def: A unit of liquid equal to about four litres.

tourism--noun.def: The business of providing holidays for visitors.

undergo--verb.def: To experience something, especially a change or treatment.

refusal--noun.def: The act of saying no to something.

hearty--adj.def: Warm and friendly, or large and filling.

diameter--noun.def: The distance across a circle through its centre.
diameter--noun.ex: The pipe has a wide diameter.

liberate--verb.def: To set a place or people free.
liberate--verb.ex: The town was liberated in autumn.

tumble--verb.def: To fall suddenly and roll over.
tumble--verb.ex: The boxes tumbled off the cart.

newcomer--noun.def: A person who has recently arrived.
newcomer--noun.ex: The newcomer sat at the back.

ironing--noun.def: The job of pressing clothes with a hot iron.

genetics--noun.def: The study of how features pass to children.

compose--verb.def: To write music, or to form something.

smoker--noun.def: A person who smokes cigarettes regularly.
smoker--noun.ex: He has been a smoker for years.

citizenship--noun.def: The legal right to belong to a country.

turbulence--noun.def: Sudden violent movement of air or water.
turbulence--noun.ex: We hit turbulence over the mountains.

complicate--verb.def: To make something harder to deal with.

lifeguard--noun.def: A person who watches swimmers and saves them.

firefighter--noun.def: A person whose job is putting out fires.

traditionally--adv.def: In the way that has been usual for a long time.
traditionally--adv.ex: The dish is traditionally served cold.
traditionally--adv.exTr: Yemek geleneksel olarak soğuk servis edilir.

endanger--verb.def: To put someone or something at risk.

carton--noun.def: A light box made of cardboard.

penniless--adj.ex: He arrived penniless in the city.

prohibition--noun.def: An official rule that forbids something.
prohibition--noun.ex: There is a prohibition on fishing here.

requirement--noun.def: Something that is needed or demanded.
requirement--noun.ex: A licence is a legal requirement.

diverse--adj.ex: The city has a diverse population.

novelist--noun.ex: The novelist lives near the sea.

emphasis--noun.ex: The course puts emphasis on speaking.

moderate--adj.def: Neither very large nor very small.
moderate--adj.exTr: Her gün orta düzeyde egzersiz yap.

rainforest--noun.def: A thick forest in a hot area with heavy rain.

characteristic--noun.def: A typical quality of a person or a thing.

enjoyment--noun.def: The pleasure you get from something.

unheard--adj.def: Not listened to, or never known before.

shiver--verb.def: To shake slightly because you are cold or afraid.

animated--adj.def: Full of energy, or made using animation.

unfold--verb.def: To open something folded, or to develop gradually.
unfold--verb.ex: Unfold the map on the table.

deprive--verb.def: To take something important away from someone.
deprive--verb.ex: The illness deprived him of sleep.

accessible--adj.def: Easy to reach, enter or understand.
accessible--adj.ex: The beach is accessible by bus.

nucleus--noun.def: The central part of an atom or a cell.
nucleus--noun.ex: The nucleus holds the cell's genes.

upward--adj.def: Moving or pointing towards a higher place.
upward--adj.ex: There is an upward trend in prices.
upward--adj.exTr: Fiyatlarda yukarı doğru bir eğilim var.

biography--noun.def: The story of a person's life written by someone else.
biography--noun.ex: She read a biography of Atatürk.

copyright--noun.def: The legal right to control who copies a work.

glide--noun.def: A smooth movement through air or over a surface.

schoolteacher--noun.def: A person who teaches in a school.

brightly--adv.def: With a lot of light or colour.

meditate--verb.def: To sit quietly and calm your mind.

widespread--adj.def: Found or happening over a large area.

quake--noun.def: A shaking of the ground, short for earthquake.

nutrition--noun.def: The process of getting the food your body needs.
nutrition--noun.exTr: İyi beslenme çocukların büyümesine yardımcı olur.
